shoulder-length platinum white hair with straight bangs and a smooth texture. sharp light blue eyes with a neutral, stoic expression. apparent age of seventeen with a mature, composed face. slender build. a high-collared white and blue futuristic school uniform with a short pleated skirt and a blue necktie. signature details include a small robotic halo floating above the head and a large, high-tech railgun weapon.
BODY COLOR: pale porcelain skin
